marketing_description: The Milwaukee 3054-20 M12 Fuel Series 1/2 in. Square Drive Ratchet features a POWERSTATE Brushless Motor and REDLINK PLUS Intelligence for efficient performance. With a variable speed control and 2-speed gearbox, this ratchet provides a high torque rating of 45 ft-lb. Its compact design and ergonomic contoured grip make it suitable for a variety of applications.
